blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection, providing natural-language explanations for authenticity judgments.
However, their ability to interpret text within images may also expose these judgments to misleading semantic cues.
We systematically evaluate typographic attack strategies across detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs, considering both real-to-fake and fake-to-real attacks.
Our results show that reasoning modes generally exhibit greater vulnerability than direct modes and that attack effectiveness exhibits pronounced directional asymmetry.
Moreover, larger models tend to exhibit higher clean detection accuracy but also higher attack success rates.
We further examine attack robustness under image and text transformations and investigate whether overlays indicating the correct class can aid error correction.
Together, these analyses characterize how typographic attacks influence authenticity judgments and expose limitations of current VLM-based AIGI detection systems.
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用于AI生成的图像(AIGI)检测,为真实判断提供了自然语言的解释.
然而,他们在图像中解释文本的能力也可能使这些判断暴露出误导的语义提示.
我们系统地评估各种面向检测、公开重量和商业的VLM的打字攻击战略,同时考虑真假和假假攻击。
我们的结果表明,推理模式通常比直接模式更加脆弱,而且攻击效果显示出明显的方向不对称。
此外,较大的模型往往显示出较高的清洁探测精度,但也显示出较高的攻击成功率。
我们进一步审查在图像和文本转换下的攻击强度,并调查显示正确等级的重叠是否有助于修正错误。
这些分析共同说明了打字攻击如何影响真实性的判断,并揭露了目前基于甚高频的AIGI检测系统的局限性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Advances in generative modeling have improved the visual fidelity and diversity of AI-generated images (AIGIs).
As AIGIs become harder to distinguish from photographs, AIGI detection has attracted growing interest, as reflected in the development of diverse benchmarks [ 26 , 29 ] .
Meanwhile, vision-language models (VLMs) trained on large-scale multimodal data support diverse applications through visual recognition and reasoning [ 6 , 3 ] .
In AIGI detection, VLMs can combine visual evidence and semantic knowledge for classification and natural-language explanations.
Recent studies develop detection-oriented VLMs through task-specific training to improve authenticity classification and artifact explanation [ 25 , 10 , 21 , 24 , 20 ] .
blocks.zh:
基因模型学的进步提高了AI生成图像的视觉忠诚度和多样性.
随着AIGI越来越难与相片相区别,AIGI的探测已经引起了越来越多的兴趣,这体现在各种基准的制定[26,29].
同时,接受大规模多模式数据培训的视觉语言模型通过视觉识别和推理支持各种应用[6,3].
在AIGI检测中,VLMs可以结合视觉证据和语义知识进行分类和自然语言解释.
最近的研究通过针对具体任务的培训,开发出以检测为导向的甚高分辨率材料,以改进真实性分类和文物解释[25,10,21,24,20].

blocks.en:
However, broader VLM use raises practical concerns about robustness to adversarial manipulation of textual and visual inputs [ 27 , 19 ] .
Among these, typographic attacks introduce misleading text into images [ 7 , 16 ] .
Such attacks can add or modify text using standard image-editing tools without accessing the model’s internal prompts.
Prior work examines misleading text and related artifacts in visual recognition and geolocation [ 16 , 17 , 28 ] , while FigStep uses typographic prompts to bypass safety alignment [ 8 ] .
Related studies also report a preference for text over visual information when modalities conflict [ 4 ] .
For AIGI detection, overlaid authenticity claims may thus bias detector judgments without establishing image provenance.
Despite these threats, the robustness of VLM-based AIGI detection to typographic attacks remains underexplored .
An initial study [ 13 ] reports a 6.6% attack success rate (ASR) against zero-shot GPT-4o detection on Celeb-DF [ 14 ] using a file-path overlay suggesting authentic provenance.
However, evaluating one VLM and overlay for fake-to-real evasion leaves several important issues unclear, such as how vulnerability varies across general-purpose and specialized detectors and typographic designs, and whether attacks succeed in both directions (real → \rightarrow fake, fake → \rightarrow real).
blocks.zh:
然而,更广泛地使用VLM引起了人们的实际关切,即对文字和视觉投入进行对抗性操纵的力度[27,19]。
其中,打字攻击将误导文字引入图像[7,16].
这类攻击可以使用标准图像编辑工具来添加或修改文本,而无需访问模型的内部提示.
之前的工作在视觉识别和地理定位[16,17,28]中研究了误导文本和相关文物,而FigStep则使用打字提示来绕过安全对接[8].
相关研究还报告说,在模式冲突时,倾向于文本而不是视觉信息[4]。
就AIGI的探测而言,重叠的真实性主张可能因此在不确定图像出处的情况下对探测器作出偏差判断。
尽管存在这些威胁,基于VLM的AIGI探测到的打字攻击的力度仍然不足。
一项初步研究[13] 报告说,Celeb-DF上的零射出GPT-4o探测器的进攻成功率(ASR)为6.6%,使用文件路径覆盖显示真实出处。
然而,评估一个甚高频和对假到真实逃逸的重叠,使得几个重要问题不明确,例如通用和专用探测器以及打字设计的脆弱性如何不同,攻击是否双向成功(真-正-正-正-正-正-正-正).

blocks.en:
In this work, we systematically evaluate typographic attacks against various VLMs (detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs), comparing four adapted attacks with a random-text control in both directions.
We find that reasoning modes are generally more vulnerable than direct modes, effective cues differ by attack direction, and larger models achieve higher clean accuracy while often exhibiting higher ASR.
We also test attack robustness under JPEG compression [ 23 ] , downsampling, multilingual perturbations [ 5 ] , and typographical errors [ 2 ] .
Furthermore, inspired by Amicable Aid [ 11 ] , we apply overlays supporting the correct class to initially misclassified images, probing whether typographic vulnerability reflects a broader tendency to follow textual class cues.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们系统地评价了针对各种VLM的打字攻击(以检测为导向,开放重量,以及商业VLM),比较了四个经过调整的攻击和两个方向的随机文字控制.
我们发现推理模式通常比直接模式更脆弱,有效的提示因攻击方向不同而不同,更大的模型实现更干净的精度,同时往往表现出更高的ASR.
我们还在JPEG压缩下测试强性 [23],下采样,多语言扰动 [5],和打字错误 [2].
此外,在Amicable Aid [11] 的启发下,我们应用支持正确类的叠加来进行最初的分类错误的图像,检验打字能力是否反映了遵循文字类提示的更广泛趋势.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • To our knowledge, we provide the first systematic assessment of typographic vulnerability in VLM-based AIGI detection . • We characterize typographic vulnerability across inference modes, attack directions, model families, and scales, revealing systematic differences in how VLMs respond to textual cues. • We assess attack persistence under image and text transformations and use correct-class overlays to probe the broader influence of textual cues on authenticity judgments.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 据我们所知,我们在基于甚高分辨率和高分辨率的AIGI探测中提供了对打字脆弱性的第一次系统评估。 我们描述各种推论模式、攻击方向、模型家族和尺度的打字脆弱性,揭示VLM如何对文字提示作出反应的系统差异。 我们评估图像和文本转换下的攻击持久性,并使用正确分类的叠加来探究文字提示对真实性判断的更广泛影响。

blocks.en: To our knowledge, we provide the first systematic assessment of typographic vulnerability in VLM-based AIGI detection .
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,我们提供了对基于甚高频的AIGI检测中打印脆弱性的第一次系统评估。

blocks.en: We characterize typographic vulnerability across inference modes, attack directions, model families, and scales, revealing systematic differences in how VLMs respond to textual cues.
blocks.zh: 我们描述各种推论模式、攻击方向、模式家族和尺度的打印脆弱性,揭示了VLM如何响应文字提示的系统差异。

blocks.en: We assess attack persistence under image and text transformations and use correct-class overlays to probe the broader influence of textual cues on authenticity judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们评估图像和文本转换下的攻击持久性,并使用正确分类的叠加来探究文字提示对真实性判断的更广泛影响。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
VLM-based AIGI Detection. Recent VLM-based detectors combine authenticity classification with natural-language explanations.
FakeVLM [ 25 ] learns from artifact descriptions, while Ivy-xDetector [ 10 ] and BusterX++ [ 24 ] employ reinforcement learning for explainable image and video detection.
Veritas [ 21 , 20 ] incorporates planning and self-reflection to improve generalization.
blocks.zh:
VLM基于AIGI检测. 最近的基于VLM的探测器结合了真实性分类和自然语言解释.
FakeVLM [25] 从文物描述中学习,而Ivy-x检测器 [10]和Buster [24] 则使用强化学习来进行可解释的图像和视频检测.
Veritas [21, 20] 包含了规划和自我反省,以改善通俗化.

blocks.en:
Typographic Attack on VLMs. Prior studies manipulate VLMs through misleading class labels [ 7 ] , self-generated deceptive descriptions [ 16 ] , and typographic instructions [ 8 ] .
Web Artifact Attacks [ 17 ] extend these manipulations to non-class text and graphical cues.
Levy and Liebmann [ 13 ] provide an early demonstration of file-path overlays against GPT-4o deepfake detection.
We systematically evaluate these vulnerabilities across general-purpose and detection-oriented VLMs.
blocks.zh:
对VLM的打字攻击. 先前的研究通过误导类标签来操纵VLM[7],自发产生欺骗性描述[16],并打字说明[8].
Web Artifact attack [17] 将这些操纵扩展到非类文本和图形提示.
Levy and Liebmann [13] 提供了针对GPT-4o深假检测的文件路径覆盖的早期演示.
我们系统地评估这些脆弱性,包括一般用途和以检测为主的VLM。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Attack Methods
blocks.zh: 3.1 攻击方法

blocks.en:
We adapt four attacks from prior work, among which only File Path [ 13 ] has previously been evaluated for AIGI detection.
Visual examples of the attacks are shown in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh:
我们从之前的作品中适应了4个攻击,其中只有文件路径[13]之前曾被评估过AIGI检测.
图1显示了攻击的可视实例。

blocks.en:
Random Text. We include randomly generated text as a control to assess the contribution of attack-specific content.
Each text is constructed by selecting two fixed-length words (5 and 6, respectively) from a predefined list, and concatenating them with a space ( e.g. , ‘piano basket’ ).
Text string remains identical across all evaluated models.
blocks.zh:
随机文字. 我们列入了随机生成的文本,作为评估具体攻击内容贡献的控制.
每个文本都是通过从一个预先定义的列表中选择两个固定长词(分别为5个和6个)并用一个空格(例如 " 钢琴篮子 " )来构建的。
在所有被评价的模型中,文本字符串保持不变。

blocks.en:
Class Label. Goh et al. [ 7 ] demonstrated that misleading class labels placed on images can redirect CLIP predictions.
We adapt this strategy using authenticity labels, e.g. , REAL , to induce the target prediction.
blocks.zh:
分类标签。 高克等编. [7] 证明在图像上贴出误导类标签可以重新定向CLIP预测.
我们使用真实性标签来调整这个策略,例如Real,以诱导目标预测.

blocks.en:
Instruction. FigStep [ 8 ] renders harmful instructions as images to bypass VLM safety alignment.
We adapt this idea to authenticity classification by overlaying explicit response directives, e.g. , Answer: REAL .
blocks.zh:
指令. FigStep [8] 将有害指令作为图像来绕过 VLM 安全校正.
我们通过覆盖明确的反应指令,例如, " 回答:真实的 " ,使这一想法适应真实性的分类。

blocks.en:
File Path. Levy and Liebmann [ 13 ] use file-path overlays suggesting authentic provenance to mislead GPT-4o in deepfake detection.
We construct analogous paths containing the target label, e.g. , .../real/...png , for each attack direction.
blocks.zh:
文件路径 。 Levy and Liebmann [13] 使用文件路径覆盖表示真实出处来误导GPT-4o 在深假检测中.
我们构建包含目标标签的类似路径,例如./real/.png,用于每个攻击方向.

blocks.en:
Logo. Web Artifact Attacks [ 17 ] search for textual and graphical artifacts that exploit learned associations in VLMs.
We select a Getty Images logo 1 1 1 Wikimedia Commons. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Getty_Images_logo.svg or a Gemini logo 2 2 2 Google, via Wikimedia Commons. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Google_Gemini_logo.svg as an overlay intended to induce real or fake predictions, respectively.
blocks.zh:
卢高. 网络人工攻击 [17] 寻找利用VLMs中学习到的社团的文字和图形文物.
我们选择了Getty Images标志 11 1 Wikimedia Communitys. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Getty_Images_logo.svg或双子星标志 2 2 2 Google,通过Wikimedia Communitys. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Google_Gemini_logo.svg 分别作为意在诱导真假预测的叠加.

blocks.en: 3.2 VLM Detectors
blocks.zh: 3.2 VLM 探测器

blocks.en:
We evaluate three groups of VLM detectors.
For models supporting both direct and reasoning modes, we compare both settings using the same checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了三组VLM探测器.
对于支持直接模式和推理模式的模型,我们用同一个检查点来比较两种设置.

blocks.en: Detection-oriented VLMs. We evaluate Ivy-xDetector [ 10 ] , Veritas++ [ 20 ] , and BusterX++ [ 24 ] to examine the robustness of models specialized for AIGI detection.
blocks.zh: 以检测为主的VLM. 我们评估Ivy-x检测器 [10],Veritas++ [20],以及Buster X++ [24],以检查AIGI检测专用模型的稳健性.

blocks.en: Open-weight VLMs. We evaluate the Qwen3.8-24B [ 18 ] and GLM-4.6V-Flash [ 9 ] models.
blocks.zh: 开放式VLMs. 我们评价了Qwen3.8-24B[18]和GLM-4.6V-Flash[9]型号.

blocks.en: Commercial VLMs. We evaluate OpenAI GPT-5.4 [ 15 ] and Claude Sonnet 5 [ 1 ] , two proprietary VLMs supporting image inputs, to assess the vulnerability of commercial VLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们评价OpenAI GPT-5.4[15]和Claude Sonnet 5[1],这是支持图像输入的两种专有VLM,以评估商业VLM的脆弱性。

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价数据集

blocks.en:
We employ on Ivy-Fake [ 10 ] and GenImage [ 29 ] .
For Ivy-Fake, we use 1,250 real and 1,250 fake images from its image test set.
For GenImage, we construct a subset containing 909 real and 1,000 fake images.
We restrict the GenImage subset to images with both width and height of at least 512 pixels to focus the evaluation on higher-resolution inputs.
blocks.zh:
我们雇佣常春藤假 [10] 和GenImage [29]。
对常春藤假象来说,我们使用了1,250个真实的和1,250个假的图像,从它的图像测试集.
对于GenImage,我们构建一个子集,包含909个真实图像和1000个假图像.
我们把GenImage子集限制在宽度和高度都至少为512像素的图像上,以便把评价的重点放在高分辨率输入上.

blocks.en:
For the experiments in Secs. 4.2 – 4.3 and 4.5 , we use a fixed subset of 100 real and 100 fake images from the Ivy-Fake test set that both Ivy and Veritas++ correctly classify under clean conditions.
For Sec. 4.4 , we construct two model-specific subsets, one for Ivy and one for Veritas++.
Each subset contains 100 images from the Ivy-Fake test set that the corresponding model misclassifies under clean conditions, allowing us to assess whether typographic cues can help correct detection errors.
blocks.zh:
对于Secs. 4.2 – 4.3和 4.5中的实验,我们使用从常春藤-假想测试中得出的由100个真实和100个假相组成的固定子集,常春藤和Veritas++在干净的条件下正确分类.
对于4.4sec,我们构建出两个模型特有的子集,一个用于常春藤,一个用于Veritas++.
每个子集包含来自常春藤-假想测试集的100个图像,相应的模型在干净的条件下错误分类,使我们能够评估打字提示是否能够帮助纠正检测错误.

blocks.en: 3.4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.4 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
Text overlays use a font size of 0.06 × min ⁡ ( W , H ) 0.06\times\min(W,H) pixels, where W W and H H denote the image width and height, respectively.
We place text at the top center with opacity 0.95 0.95 , selecting black or white text depending on local background luminance.
Logos preserve their aspect ratios and match the visible height of a single text line.
These parameters choices are ablated further in Sec. 4.5 .
blocks.zh:
文本覆盖使用字体大小为0.06 × min ⁡ (W, H) 0.06\times\min (W, H) 像素,其中W W和H H分别表示图像宽度和高度.
我们用不透明 0.95 0.95 将文本放在顶端, 根据本地背景的亮度来选择黑色或白色文本 。
Logos 保留了它们的外观比并匹配单个文本行的可见高.
这些参数选择在4.5节中进一步减少。

blocks.en:
All locally hosted VLMs are evaluated using vLLM [ 12 ] with greedy decoding.
For detection-oriented VLMs, we follow the prompt templates provided in their official implementations.
Qwen, GLM, GPT-5.4, and Sonnet 5 receive the query Is this image real or fake? and a shared system prompt specifying the detection task and requesting a final Real or Fake verdict.
ASR is computed over images correctly classified by each model and inference mode on clean inputs, where invalid or incomplete outputs are counted as unsuccessful attacks.
blocks.zh:
所有本地主机VLM都使用vLLM[12]进行评估,并进行贪婪的解码.
对于以检测为导向的甚高频,我们遵循在其正式实施中提供的即时模板。
Quen、GLM、GPT-5.4和Sonnet 5收到查询 这是真实的还是假的? 和共享系统提示检测任务,并请求最终的Real或假判决。
ASR是根据每个模型和关于清洁输入的推论模式正确分类的图像计算的,其中无效或不完整的输出被算作不成功的攻击.

blocks.en: 4 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 分析

blocks.en: 4.1 Overall Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 总结果

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 and Tab. 2 show that typographic attacks substantially compromise AIGI detection across the evaluated model families.
Although Random Text also induces errors, Class Label and Instruction consistently achieve higher ASR.
In particular, Instruction outperforms Random Text despite matching its character count and rendering settings, indicating that textual semantics contribute to attack effectiveness beyond mere visual occlusion.
blocks.zh:
标签1和标签。 2 显示打字攻击大大地损害了AIGI在被评价的模范家庭的检测。
虽然随机 文本还引起错误,分类标签和指令始终实现更高的ASR.
特别是,"指令"虽然符合其字符计数和渲染设置,但仍优于"随机文字",表明"文字语义"有助于攻击有效性,超越了单纯的视觉隔离.

blocks.en:
Direct vs. Reasoning. Across the four adapted attacks, reasoning mode yields higher ASR than direct mode in 42 of 48 matched comparisons, with particularly large increases for BusterX++ and Qwen.
Qualitative reasoning outputs in Fig. 2(a) further suggest that reasoning can incorporate misleading text into the evidence supporting its verdict.
While this vulnerability is generally more pronounced in reasoning mode, its magnitude varies across models and attack directions.
For example, the direct–reasoning gap tends to be smaller for GLM, and some F → \rightarrow R attacks on Qwen with GenImage are less effective in reasoning mode.
blocks.zh:
直接对治. 在经过调整的4起攻击中,推理模式在48起比较中的42起比较中得出了高于直接模式的ASR,而Buster-Q和Quen的增幅尤其大.
图2(a)中的定性推理产出还表明,推理可以将误导性案文纳入支持其判决的证据。
虽然这种脆弱性一般在推理模式中更为明显,但其规模因模型和攻击方向而异.
例如,对GLM来说,直接的-理性差距往往较小,一些F ~\右旋R用GenImage攻击Quen在推理模式上效果较差.

蓝色高亮文本表示攻击失败,红色高亮文本表示攻击成功.

blocks.en:
Model Families. Across all three model families–detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs–vulnerability depends strongly on the attack type and direction, and no family is unifomrly robust.
On Ivy-Fake, Ivy and Veritas++ show relatively low R → \rightarrow F ASRs but remain highly susceptible to the Instruction attack in the F → \rightarrow R direction, whereas BusterX++ exhibits severe vulnerability to the File Path attack in the R → \rightarrow F direction.
On GenImage, the Logo attack likewise achieves high F → \rightarrow R ASRs against commercial models, reaching 58.92% for GPT-5.4 and 37.99% for Sonnet 5.
blocks.zh:
模范家庭报. 所有三个模范家庭 — — 以检测为导向、开放重量和商业VLM — — 的脆弱性在很大程度上取决于攻击的类型和方向,没有哪个家庭是强而有力的。
在"Ivy-Fake"上,"Ivy"和"Veritas++"显示出相对较低的"R →"相克F ASR",但依然极易受"指令"指向"F"方向的攻击";而"Buster"则表现出了在"R"指向"相克F"方向"文件路径攻击"的严重脆弱性.
在"GenImage"上,"Logo"攻击同样实现了高F ~\正弦R ASR来对抗商业模型,GPT-5.4%和Sonnet 5.37.99%.

blocks.en:
Directional Asymmetry. Attack effectiveness depends strongly on direction: File Path generally achieves the highest R → \rightarrow F ASR, whereas Instruction or Logo is strongest for F → \rightarrow R.
File Path is consistently more effective for R → \rightarrow F across models except for Ivy and Veritas++.
The example in Fig. 2(b) suggests that models accept paths implying AI generation as evidence but dismiss those claiming authenticity as misleading.
Thus, recognizing embedded text does not necessarily imply accepting it as evidence.
blocks.zh:
方向不对称. 攻击效果在很大程度上取决于方向: 文件路径一般实现最高的R →\正中F ASR,而指令或Logo对F →\正中R最强.
文件路径对于R →\直径F跨型号来说,除了Ivy和Veritas++之外,始终更有效.
图2(b)中的例子表明,模型接受暗示AI生成的路径作为证据,但排除那些声称真实性误导的人。
因此,承认嵌入式文本并不一定意味着接受其为证据。

blocks.en: 4.2 Model Scale and Vulnerability
blocks.zh: 4.2 模型规模和脆弱性

blocks.en:
To examine the effect of model scale, we evaluate Qwen3.5–4B, –9B, and –27B [ 22 ] , since Qwen3.8 variants at multiple scales are unavailable.
All three variants operate in reasoning mode.
Tab. 3 shows that the averaged clean accuracy across real and fake images improves with model size.
The 4B model achieves 90% accuracy on real images but only 50% on fake images, whereas the 27B model achieves 80% and 88%, respectively.
blocks.zh:
为了审查模型尺度的效果,我们评价了Quen3.5–4B,-9B,和-27B[22],因为没有多种尺度的Quen3.8个变体.
所有三种变体都以推理模式运作.
Tab. 3显示,真实和假图像的平均清洁准确度随着模型大小而提高.
4B模型在真实图像上实现了90%的精度,而假图像上只有50%,而27B模型分别实现了80%和88%.

blocks.en:
Meanwhile, attacks tend to be more effective at larger model scales despite gains in clean accuracy: either the 9B or 27B model attains the highest ASR in seven of the ten settings.
The comparatively modest changes for Random Text suggest that this increased vulnerability may reflect a greater influence of embedded textual semantics.
The increase in vulnerability is more pronounced from 4B to 9B, whereas the differences between 9B and 27B are less consistent.
blocks.zh:
同时,攻击往往在更大的模型尺度上更为有效,尽管在清洁准确性方面有所改进:9B或27B模型在10个设置中,有7个达到最高的ASR.
" 随机文字 " 的比较小的改动表明,这种脆弱性的增加可能反映出嵌入式文字语义的较大影响。
脆弱性从4B增加至9B增加更为明显,而9B和27B之间的差异则不太一致。

blocks.en: 4.3 Attack Robustness
blocks.zh: 4.3 攻击力

blocks.en:
We evaluate attack robustness on a shared subset of 100 real and 100 fake images that are correctly classified by both Ivy and Veritas++.
For image perturbations, we apply JPEG compression ( Q ∈ { 75 , 50 , 25 } Q\in\{75,50,25\} ) and downsampling ( s ∈ { 0.9 , 0.75 , 0.5 } s\in\{0.9,0.75,0.5\} ) to attacked images.
For text perturbations, we translate English overlays into Korean, Chinese, and Spanish, and also introduce substitutions with neighboring QWERTY keys at nominal rates of 10 % 10\% , 20 % 20\% , and 30 % 30\% .
Characters are selected with these rates for short prompts and word occurrences for File Path, with one character modified per selected word.
Logo is evaluated only under image transformations.
Fig. 3 presents combined ASR averaged over both models.
blocks.zh:
我们评价攻击强性 在100个真实和100个假图像的共享子集上 被常春藤和Veritas++正确分类
对于图像扰动,我们应用了JPEG压缩(QQ {75,50,25}Q\in\{75,50,25\})和下采样(s∈{0.9,0.75,0.5})来攻击图像.
对于文本扰动,我们将英语的重叠部分翻译成韩语、汉语和西班牙语,并采用相邻的 QWERTY 键的替换方式,其名义比率为 10%- 10%- , 20%- 20- 和 30%- 30- 。
为文件路径的短提示和单词出错选择字符,每个选定单词修改一个字符。
logo只在图像转换下进行评估.
图3列出两个模型的合并ASR平均值。

blocks.en:
JPEG compression and downsampling increase ASR above the reference, but accompanying clean-image errors suggest that this reflects weakened visual evidence rather than stronger textual influence alone.
Text perturbations instead reveal robustness that depends on attack design and direction.
Translation sharply reduces R → \rightarrow F ASR for Class Label and Instruction, while Instruction and File Path retain substantial F → \rightarrow R success across languages.
Typos show a similar attack-specific pattern, progressively weakening Instruction while leaving File Path comparatively stable, possibly because its path structure remains recognizable.
blocks.zh:
JPEG压缩和下采样将ASR提升到参考值以上,但相伴而来的清洁图像错误表明,这反映了视觉证据被削弱,而不是单靠更强大的文字影响.
相反,文字扰动揭示出依赖攻击设计和取向的坚固性.
翻译大幅减少 R \ 右侧 F ASR 用于分类标签和指令,而指令和文件路径则保留了大量 F \ 右侧 R 跨语言的成功 。
Typos显示了类似的攻击特异性模式,在离开文件路径相对稳定的同时逐渐削弱指令,可能是因为其路径结构仍然可以识别.

blocks.en: 4.4 Amicable Aid
blocks.zh: 4.4 可计量的援助

blocks.en:
To further understand whether attack success reflects textual semantics rather than visual occlusion alone, we reverse the setting following Amicable Aid [ 11 ] .
Each model is evaluated on 100 images it misclassifies without typographies.
We then add typography supporting the ground-truth class. For example, a real image misclassified as fake receives a REAL cue, and vice versa.
Recovery rate measures the fraction of these errors corrected, with Random Text as a non-targeted control.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步理解攻击成功是否反映了文字语义而不是光是视觉隔离,我们扭转了随后的可模仿援助[11].
每个模型在100个图像上进行评价,这些图像在没有打字的情况下被错误分类。
然后我们添加支持地面真实课的打字技术. 例如,一个真实的图像被错误地归类为假的会收到一个真实的提示,反之亦然.
回收率测量这些错误的分数得到纠正,随机文字作为非目标控制.

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 4 , all four aids outperform Random Text in average recovery, indicating that semantic agreement with the ground truth matters beyond the presence of text alone.
Instruction performs best on Ivy at 74.0%, whereas Class Label performs best on Veritas++ at 61.0%, exceeding Random Text by 36.0 pp and 46.0 pp, respectively.
Together with the attack results, this reversal shows that VLMs incorporate the semantic content of overlaid typography into their authenticity judgments.
blocks.zh:
如塔布所显示. 4,所有四种助词在平均恢复中都超过了"随机文本",表明与地表真理的语义协议在仅存在文本之外是重要的.
常春藤的教学成绩最好,为74.0%,而类标签在Veritas++上表现最好,为61.0%,分别超过36.0页和46.0页。
与攻击结果一起,这种倒置表明VLMs将上层打字的语义内容融入了他们的真实判断中.

blocks.en:
We examine how overlay position, font size, and opacity affect attack effectiveness on Ivy and Veritas++.
Tab. 5 reports ASR aggregated over four attacks and both directions, excluding Random Text.
Position has a modest and model-dependent effect, with pooled ASR ranging from 34.31% to 37.94%.
Font size and opacity show clearer trends: pooled ASR increases from 22.69% to 36.63% as the font-size fraction increases from 0.02 to 0.10, and from 12.50% to 34.31% as opacity increases from 0.05 to 0.95.
However, a font-size fraction of 0.10 frequently causes rendering failures.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了重叠位置、字体大小和不透明如何影响常春藤和Veritas++的攻击效果。
Tab.5报告ASR汇总了4起攻击和双向攻击,不包括"随机文字".
职位具有适度和依赖模型的作用,集合ASR从34.31%到37.94%不等.
字体大小和不透明显示出更明确的趋势:集合ASR从22.69%增加到36.63%,因为字体大小的分数从0.02增加到0.10;不透明从0.05增加到0.95,从12.50%增加到34.31%。
然而,字体大小为0.10的分数往往会造成渲染失败.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we systematically evaluated four adapted typographic attacks against detection-oriented, open-weight, and commercial VLMs for AIGI detection.
The results reveal substantial susceptibility, with reasoning modes generally exhibiting higher ASR and attack effectiveness varying markedly by direction. Additional analyses show that higher clean accuracy does not ensure lower ASR, common image transformations fail to reliably mitigate attacks, and truth-aligned typography can recover selected detection errors.
These findings highlight the need for VLM-based AIGI detectors to distinguish overlaid authenticity claims from visual evidence.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们系统地评价了四次经过调整的对面向检测、开放重量和商业VLM的打字攻击,用于AIGI检测。
结果表明,存在相当的易感性,推理模式一般表现出较高的主动性,攻击效果因方向而异。 其他分析显示,更干净的精度并不能保证较低的ASR,常见的图像转换无法可靠地减轻攻击,而真实相通的打字法可以恢复选定的检测出错.
这些调查结果突出表明,基于VLM的AIGI探测器需要区分所覆盖的真实性主张和视觉证据。

blocks.en:
Discussion. Our experiments identify greater vulnerability in reasoning modes, but do not fully explain why these modes are often more susceptible or what determines attack success and failure.
Investigating these factors could inform new typographic attacks specifically targeting reasoning-based VLMs.
blocks.zh:
讨论。 我们的实验发现在推理模式中存在更大的脆弱性,但并未充分解释为什么这些模式往往更易受影响,或者是什么决定了攻击的成败。
调查这些因素可以为新的打字攻击提供信息,特别是针对基于推理的VLM。
